optical_power_max.note: Laser output at the sample plane. The highest point the dial reached under measurement; the next point up over-ranged the meter and is an extrapolation, not a measurement.

confirmation.how: Measured at the sample plane with a Thorlabs power meter across the dial range, by the person recording it here. The bench work predates this entry; what is dated today is this person confirming it holds for this instrument as configured.

objective_clearance_min.note: A floor, not a ceiling: the objective may not come closer than this.
